model_output:
```sql
WITH hotel_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Hampton Inn & Suites Artesia'
    AND addr_state = 'NM'
    AND addr_city = 'Artesia'
),
high_elevation_areas AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    rast,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakeBox2D(ST_Transform(geometry, 4326)), 4326)
  )
),
clipped_high_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, ST_Transform(geometry, 4326)) AS rast
  FROM high_elevation_areas, hotel_geom
),
elevation_buffer AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry, 4326), 2500) AS buffer_geom
  FROM hotel_geom
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(ST_Intersection(clipped_high_elevation.rast, elevation_buffer.buffer_geom)) AS rast
  FROM clipped_high_elevation, elevation_buffer
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    hotel_geom.id,
    hotel_geom.geometry
  FROM hotel_geom
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM elevation_analysis
    WHERE ST_ValueCount(rast, 1, 2000, true) > 0
  )
)
SELECT 
  poi_name,
  addr_city,
  addr_state
FROM pois
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT id FROM final_result
);
```
